verses.t: The swine that died in Gadara two thousand years ago Went mad in lofty places, with results that all men know-- Went mad in lofty places through long rooting in the dirt, Which (even for swine) begets at last soul-satisfying hurt.

The swine in lofty places now are matter for no song
By any prudent singer, but--how long, O Lord, how long?
